{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Finsupp.multinomial",
      "informal_name": "Multinomial coefficient",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "{α : Type u_1} → (α →₀ ℕ) → ℕ",
      "informal_description": "The multinomial coefficient for a finite support function $ f $, defined as $ \\frac{(\\sum_{a} f(a))!}{\\prod_{a} f(a)!} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finsupp.multinomial_update",
      "informal_name": "Multinomial Coefficient Decomposition via Binomial Coefficient and Updated Function",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} (a : α) (f : α →₀ ℕ), f.multinomial = (f.sum fun x => id).choose (f a) * (f.update a 0).multinomial",
      "informal_description": "For a finite support function $ f : \\alpha \\to_0 \\mathbb{N} $ and an element $ a \\in \\alpha $, the multinomial coefficient of $ f $ satisfies $ \\frac{(\\sum f)!}{\\prod f!} = \\binom{\\sum f}{f(a)} \\cdot \\frac{(\\sum f - f(a))!}{\\prod_{b \\neq a} f(b)!} $. This expresses the multinomial coefficient as the product of a binomial coefficient $ \\binom{\\sum f}{f(a)} $ and the multinomial coefficient of the function $ f $ with its value at $ a $ set to zero.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.binomial_eq_choose",
      "informal_name": "Multinomial Coefficient Equals Binomial Coefficient for Two-Element Sets",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ℕ} {a b : α} [inst : DecidableEq α],\n  a ≠ b → Nat.multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b).choose (f a)",
      "informal_description": "For a finite set $ s = \\{a, b\\} $ with $ a \\neq b $ and a function $ f : s \\to \\mathbb{N} $, the multinomial coefficient $ \\frac{(\\sum_{i \\in s} f(i))!}{\\prod_{i \\in s} (f(i))!} $ is equal to the binomial coefficient $ \\binom{f(a) + f(b)}{f(a)} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "BinomialRing.multichoose",
      "informal_name": "Binomial coefficient function in a binomial ring",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "{R : Type u_1} → {inst : AddCommMonoid R} → {inst_1 : Pow R ℕ} → [self : BinomialRing R] → R → ℕ → R",
      "informal_description": "The function that maps an element $ r $ of a binomial ring and a natural number $ n $ to the binomial coefficient $ \\binom{n}{k} $ evaluated at $ r $, as an element of the ring. This operation satisfies the binomial theorem identities inherent to binomial rings.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.Binomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Ring.multichoose",
      "informal_name": "Binomial coefficient function in a binomial ring",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "{R : Type u_1} → [inst : AddCommMonoid R] → [inst_1 : Pow R ℕ] → [BinomialRing R] → R → ℕ → R",
      "informal_description": "The function that maps an element $ r $ of a binomial ring and a natural number $ n $ to the binomial coefficient $ \\binom{n}{k} $ evaluated at $ r $, as an element of the ring. This operation satisfies the binomial theorem identities inherent to binomial rings.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.Binomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finsupp.multinomial_eq",
      "informal_name": "Multinomial Coefficient Equality for Finite Support Functions",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α →₀ ℕ), f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial f.support ⇑f",
      "informal_description": "For a finite support function $ f $, the multinomial coefficient $ \\text{multinomial}(f) $ is equal to the standard multinomial coefficient computed over the support of $ f $, i.e., $ \\frac{(\\sum_{i \\in \\text{support } f} f(i))!}{\\prod_{i \\in \\text{support } f} (f(i))!} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.multinomial",
      "informal_name": "Multinomial coefficient",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "{α : Type u_1} → Finset α → (α → ℕ) → ℕ",
      "informal_description": "The multinomial coefficient defined as $\\frac{(\\sum_{i \\in s} f(i))!}{\\prod_{i \\in s} (f(i))!} $ for a finite set $s$ and a function $f : s \\to \\mathbb{N}$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Finsupp.multinomial_eq_of_support_subset",
      "informal_name": "Multinomial Coefficient Equality for Subset Support",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α →₀ ℕ} {s : Finset α}, f.support ⊆ s → f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial s ⇑f",
      "informal_description": "If the support of a finite support function $ f : \\alpha \\to₀ \\mathbb{N} $ is contained within a finite set $ s \\subseteq \\alpha $, then the multinomial coefficient of $ f $ coincides with the multinomial coefficient defined on $ s $ with respect to $ f $. Formally, $ \\frac{(\\sum_{i \\in \\text{support } f} f(i))!}{\\prod_{i \\in \\text{support } f} f(i)!} = \\frac{(\\sum_{i \\in s} f(i))!}{\\prod_{i \\in s} f(i)!} $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Ring.choose",
      "informal_name": "Binomial coefficient in a binomial ring",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "{R : Type u_1} → [inst : AddCommGroupWithOne R] → [inst_1 : Pow R ℕ] → [BinomialRing R] → R → ℕ → R",
      "informal_description": "The function that maps an element $ r $ of a binomial ring and a natural number $ n $ to the binomial coefficient $ \\binom{r - n + 1}{n} $, as an element of the ring.",
      "path": "Mathlib.RingTheory.Binomial"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Nat.binomial_eq",
      "informal_name": "Multinomial Coefficient for Two Elements Equals Binomial Coefficient",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ℕ} {a b : α} [inst : DecidableEq α],\n  a ≠ b → Nat.multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b).factorial / ((f a).factorial * (f b).factorial)",
      "informal_description": "For distinct elements $a$ and $b$ in a type $\\alpha$ with decidable equality, the multinomial coefficient of the set $\\{a, b\\}$ with function $f : \\{a, b\\} \\to \\mathbb{N}$ satisfies $\\text{multinomial}(\\{a, b\\}, f) = \\frac{(f(a) + f(b))!}{f(a)! \\cdot f(b)!}$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Multinomial"
    }
  ]
}

items.informal_description: The multinomial coefficient for a finite support function $ f $, defined as $ \frac{(\sum_{a} f(a))!}{\prod_{a} f(a)!} $.

items.informal_name: Multinomial Coefficient Decomposition via Binomial Coefficient and Updated Function
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (a : α) (f : α →₀ ℕ), f.multinomial = (f.sum fun x => id).choose (f a) * (f.update a 0).multinomial
items.informal_description: For a finite support function $ f : \alpha \to_0 \mathbb{N} $ and an element $ a \in \alpha $, the multinomial coefficient of $ f $ satisfies $ \frac{(\sum f)!}{\prod f!} = \binom{\sum f}{f(a)} \cdot \frac{(\sum f - f(a))!}{\prod_{b \neq a} f(b)!} $. This expresses the multinomial coefficient as the product of a binomial coefficient $ \binom{\sum f}{f(a)} $ and the multinomial coefficient of the function $ f $ with its value at $ a $ set to zero.

items.informal_name: Multinomial Coefficient Equals Binomial Coefficient for Two-Element Sets
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ℕ} {a b : α} [inst : DecidableEq α],
  a ≠ b → Nat.multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b).choose (f a)
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s = \{a, b\} $ with $ a \neq b $ and a function $ f : s \to \mathbb{N} $, the multinomial coefficient $ \frac{(\sum_{i \in s} f(i))!}{\prod_{i \in s} (f(i))!} $ is equal to the binomial coefficient $ \binom{f(a) + f(b)}{f(a)} $.

items.informal_name: Binomial coefficient function in a binomial ring
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → {inst : AddCommMonoid R} → {inst_1 : Pow R ℕ} → [self : BinomialRing R] → R → ℕ → R
items.informal_description: The function that maps an element $ r $ of a binomial ring and a natural number $ n $ to the binomial coefficient $ \binom{n}{k} $ evaluated at $ r $, as an element of the ring. This operation satisfies the binomial theorem identities inherent to binomial rings.

items.informal_name: Binomial coefficient function in a binomial ring
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : AddCommMonoid R] → [inst_1 : Pow R ℕ] → [BinomialRing R] → R → ℕ → R
items.informal_description: The function that maps an element $ r $ of a binomial ring and a natural number $ n $ to the binomial coefficient $ \binom{n}{k} $ evaluated at $ r $, as an element of the ring. This operation satisfies the binomial theorem identities inherent to binomial rings.

items.informal_name: Multinomial Coefficient Equality for Finite Support Functions
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f : α →₀ ℕ), f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial f.support ⇑f
items.informal_description: For a finite support function $ f $, the multinomial coefficient $ \text{multinomial}(f) $ is equal to the standard multinomial coefficient computed over the support of $ f $, i.e., $ \frac{(\sum_{i \in \text{support } f} f(i))!}{\prod_{i \in \text{support } f} (f(i))!} $.

items.type: {α : Type u_1} → Finset α → (α → ℕ) → ℕ
items.informal_description: The multinomial coefficient defined as $\frac{(\sum_{i \in s} f(i))!}{\prod_{i \in s} (f(i))!} $ for a finite set $s$ and a function $f : s \to \mathbb{N}$.

items.informal_name: Multinomial Coefficient Equality for Subset Support
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α →₀ ℕ} {s : Finset α}, f.support ⊆ s → f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial s ⇑f
items.informal_description: If the support of a finite support function $ f : \alpha \to₀ \mathbb{N} $ is contained within a finite set $ s \subseteq \alpha $, then the multinomial coefficient of $ f $ coincides with the multinomial coefficient defined on $ s $ with respect to $ f $. Formally, $ \frac{(\sum_{i \in \text{support } f} f(i))!}{\prod_{i \in \text{support } f} f(i)!} = \frac{(\sum_{i \in s} f(i))!}{\prod_{i \in s} f(i)!} $.

items.informal_name: Binomial coefficient in a binomial ring
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : AddCommGroupWithOne R] → [inst_1 : Pow R ℕ] → [BinomialRing R] → R → ℕ → R
items.informal_description: The function that maps an element $ r $ of a binomial ring and a natural number $ n $ to the binomial coefficient $ \binom{r - n + 1}{n} $, as an element of the ring.

items.informal_name: Multinomial Coefficient for Two Elements Equals Binomial Coefficient
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α → ℕ} {a b : α} [inst : DecidableEq α],
  a ≠ b → Nat.multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b).factorial / ((f a).factorial * (f b).factorial)
items.informal_description: For distinct elements $a$ and $b$ in a type $\alpha$ with decidable equality, the multinomial coefficient of the set $\{a, b\}$ with function $f : \{a, b\} \to \mathbb{N}$ satisfies $\text{multinomial}(\{a, b\}, f) = \frac{(f(a) + f(b))!}{f(a)! \cdot f(b)!}$.
